source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Choose one attack benefit when you pick Var’s unit to fire during your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). The same choice applies if you pick it to fight during the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase). It can gain [[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits) against **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** targets, or [[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits) against targets with neither keyword. An active Tactical Doctrine gives the unit both effects under [Combat Doctrines](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines).
